title: On the Steiner tree connecting a fractal set
description:
Slides of the talk given on 2 June 2023 at the conference Geometric Measure Theory, Bressanone 2023 (Bressanone (Brixen), Italy, 29 May - 2 June 2023).

The slides are an HTML presentation built with reveal.js: unzip the archive and open index.html in a web browser. All dependencies are bundled, so no internet connection is needed.

Online version: https://paolini.github.io/2023-talk-Bressanone/
